title: The 2026 Story Report
country_sample: Approximately 1,000 per country; exact country and listener subgroup n not provided
recruitment: Online panels: Norstat in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Poland; JTN Research in Bulgaria
representativeness: Publisher states samples representative of each national population; weighting variables, design effect and detailed questionnaire not provided in report
genre_question: Which genres do you listen to most often?
moment_question: In what situations do you listen to books?
published_scope: Top five responses per country only
limitations: Unreported genres and occasions cannot be interpreted as zero.
These are listener preferences and occasions, not population audiobook participation.
Participation chart on page 9 has no numerical labels for total-population bars. Its bold labels mark age-group peaks. No total population percentages were imported.
The overall sample is not the denominator for listener-only percentages.
No microdata, sampling errors or confidence intervals are supplied.
Wellbeing findings are associations; no causal inference.

reporting_segments_2026.Americas: North America via Audiobooks.com and Latin America
reporting_segments_2026.APAC: Asia Pacific and Middle East excluding Israel
